name: SLS Exhaust Gas Silencer
summary: Absorptive straight-through silencer for intake or exhaust duty, with negligible back pressure.
description: The SLS series silencer is an absorptive type straight through silencer the noise being dissipated by heat resistant fibrous material. The gases flow through the silencer without obstruction resulting in negligible back pressure. Suitable for vertical and horizontal installations the SLS series silencer design gives good attenuation in the higher frequency octave band widths and is, therefore, versatile in its application as an intake or exhaust silencer on fan blowers, centrifugal compressors, internal combustion engines, and small low-pressure gas vents and steam ejectors. The SLS series silencer can also be used as a secondary silencer in conjunction with a primary reactive silencer in areas where critical levels of noise attenuation are required. The SLS 'industrial grade' absorptive silencer series are of all welded design, constructed in carbon steel, finished with one coat heat resistant black paint to ensure a long service life.
options: BS10 Table ‘D’ flanges fitted as standard
Alternative flange patterns available on request
B.S.P. connections available on smaller sizes
Heat resisting aluminium or black paint
Shot blast and aluminium metal sprayed
